infoDescription.en: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
infoDescription.zh: 在这里配置官方插件，安装和管理其他插件。内置插件列表及运行状态可在「设置 → 内置插件」中查看

error.en: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
error.zh: 可能由于网络问题，无法读取全部插件

unavailable.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
unavailable.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

restartNotice.en: The change takes effect at the next start
restartNotice.zh: 更改将在下次启动生效

overriddenNotice.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
overriddenNotice.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效

partsEmpty.en: This plugin pack contains no components.
partsEmpty.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

installDescription.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
installDescription.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。

installGuideIdTitle.en: Enter the plugin's npm package name
installGuideIdTitle.zh: 填入插件 npm 包名

installGuideIdHint.en: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
installGuideIdHint.zh: 插件包名即 npm 包名（如 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名），社区插件的 README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

installGitTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
installGitTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为实际的 Git 仓库地址

installPathTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
installPathTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为本机插件目录的实际路径

installGuideSafety.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
installGuideSafety.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。

installUpgradeNotice.en: Installed plugins do not update automatically yet. To upgrade a plugin, uninstall it and install the new version. Later releases will keep improving the upgrade experience.
installUpgradeNotice.zh: 插件安装后，暂不支持自动更新。若需升级，请先卸载再安装新版，后续版本会持续改善升级体验。

registryLegend.en: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
registryLegend.zh: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件

registryCustomHint.en: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
registryCustomHint.zh: 填写内网或私有 npm 源地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。若为需要登录的源，请把凭据放在本机的 ~/.npmrc 里。
